summary: Copel (Companhia Paranaense de Energia) filed a 6-K to disclose that its majority-owned special-purpose entity, Elejor, renegotiated the upcoming installments of public utility charges (UBP) for the Santa Clara and Fundão hydroelectric plants under Brazilian Law No. 15,235 and Aneel Order No. 668/2026. The refinancing balance of R$ 420.63 million is part of a total book balance of R$ 829.93 million; the final amount, adjusted by the SELIC rate, will be paid in June 2026. This is an ordinary regulatory/operational update, not a special situation.
